P1_thicker_level5.note: Covering at M=32, Falsifier clean, all-q Level 5. r=1 is odd_part(7n+1) (verifier worst-case 28q+1), r=17 is odd_part(3n+1) (worst-case 24q+13). Predicted affines, observed equivalent odd-part encoding.

P2_medium_still_level5.note: Energy+symbolic extractor previously covered r=1 by F^2=10q+1. Affine heads did not recover that lemma. odd_part(5n+1) does not descend, so leftover fill cannot save the class. Oracle still verified at M=32. Do not put algebraic _try_affine back in after seeing this miss.

P4_not_energy.note: No energy shortlist. TOP_K unused. Bank M=32 was proposed directly and selected on the thicker map.

P5_exact_after_round.note: Accepted affine heads are rounded integers that match F^k exactly on the train class and descend. Residues the heads miss go to odd-part fill, not a loosened threshold.

P6_no_bank_no_topk.note: Do not add moduli. Do not raise TOP_K. Do not train Collatz. Do not restore algebraic affine fit to erase P2.

lesson: Dropping the energy shortlist lets the bank include 32, and odd-part fill recovers 7n+1 / 3n+1 on the thicker map. Replacing the exact two-point affine extractor with Adam+round loses medium's F^2=10q+1. Success on the new map is not a license to weaken the old extractor or to retune after the regression.
